editorialNotes: Retain Clock Tower 3's particular heightened performance, the loss of subtle cues, motion capture as a starting point, camera scale and combat rhythm. Actual footage from the selected capcom game and frame-bound before/action/result are pinned in the catalog. Do not present second-hand directing anecdotes as our own or assert capture technology of a particular scene. The independent retro recording is higher than FHD in total samples at 1864x1440; preserve its original aspect and downscale.
